summary: Free subscription time, not cash or a $12,000 credit balance. Eligible partner-affiliated startups may get six months of Business including Notion AI; eligible non-partner startups three months. SMBs/service businesses, companies under ten employees or insufficiently verified applicants may receive one month. Requires new/non-paying Notion customer, fewer than 100 employees, company website, work-domain email, valid Notion domain and no prior Notion promotions. Three/six-month offers target scalable tech products/services. Six months requires partner code. One redemption; offers do not stack. No public campaign end date established; legal page was JS-only so separate issuance-expiry terms were not fully verified. No application or benefit delivery tested.
claim_steps: Confirm new/non-paying Notion status, fewer than 100 employees, and no previous Notion promotions.
Prepare a public company website, company-domain email and valid Notion workspace/domain.
If partner-affiliated, request the partner code; this is needed for consideration for the six-month offer.
Apply via https://www.notion.com/startups-apply and sign in; Notion determines eligibility and the 1/3/6-month benefit.
If approved, confirm the Business plan with Notion AI was applied; review billing and expiry before the free period ends.
